scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo
scripts.text: Few pressure points tend to show the same symptoms, regardless of the problem. Most of the time, the effects of pressure points will differ depending on the body's health or the time of day.

scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo
scripts.text: For instance, the pressure point located on the upper side of navel is the most vulnerable point.

scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo
scripts.text: If pressed the wrong way, it can cause death. But between 5:15 am and 7:15 am, it's just a weak point.

scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo
scripts.text: Being strong as a person is not defined as mere physical strength.

scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo

also considered when judging one's strength.

scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo
scripts.text: Let's say you're very strong and given the most powerful weapon.

scripts.speaker: Hua Tuo
scripts.text: If you don't know how to use the weapon's power, you will not be strong... You will be weak.

a poison of such potency!
W-where did you find this?
It's common nowadays.
Explain to him what happened.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Really...?
Then someone
finally figured it out.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text: I shared all of my knowledge with others, so I guess a doctor might have figured how to create this.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Now I feel depressed
for some reason...

^3355FFYou tell Nagash Arses how
Song Zhi Du created this Deadly Poison Bottle and his plan to get his revenge on the lord of Luoyang.^000000

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Will you...
Will you excuse
me for a second...?
...Nothing much.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
I guess you don't know what is going on. I've heard some bad rumors about him, which is why I'm asking.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
I hope he'll be fine.
After all, he's truly
kind at heart.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
I guess you don't know what is going on. I've heard some bad rumors about him, which is why I'm asking.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
I hope he'll be fine.
After all, he's truly
kind at heart.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Oh, you don't?
Well, that can happen
sometimes when you're
in a foreign land for
too long. I hope you
feel better soon.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Recently...
I've been getting
a bad feeling...

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
I want to blame it
on my solitude, but...
^3355FFNagash Arses. He is no longer a well-known Assassin or the martial arts organization of which he was once master has long since disbanded.^000000

^3355FFNow he is but a poor old man
who is in anguish over his disciple. No matter what you say, he continues to talk about something totally unrelated, as if in a dream.^000000

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Youngster...
I beg of you.
Please do not let him
bring any harm to the lord.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
If you cannot stop him,
then please interrupt him
from carrying out his plan.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
I tried...
To convince myself
that what I had heard
were just ugly rumors.
I was wrong...

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text: I am pretty sure he's been asking you, as well as others, for aid. Even if you do not agree to carry out his plan, I'm sure he will find someone to poison Lord Bai Long.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
There is only one way he can poison
the lord. He likes drinking, and has a favorite drink bottle he keeps with him all the time. You must get rid of his drink.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Please, I beg you.
For my sake, as well
as that of my disciple,
Luoyang's leader must live...

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
So...
What...
What happened?
I made it.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
You did?!
Oh~ thank you,
thank you so much!

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Thank God I've
lived this long.
And... I just realized
something while you away.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text: This is a journal that I have been writing for 15 years about my feelings of guilt, and what really happened in the past. I hope you can deliver this to the lord for me.

^3355FFYou obtained
^0000FFPoison King
Nagash Arses' Journal^000000.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
I hope you
can deliver this
to Lord Bai Long...

^3355FFYou gave him the
^0000FFLetter from Bai Long^000000.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text: What's this...?

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Why, he's invited me
to take the position of
a government official!
I'm truly grateful!

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
However, please let him
know that I must respectfully decline his offer. I'm afraid that I may be a burden to him once again.

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Please tell him that I wish to enjoy the rest of my life here. Also, there are people here
who still need me...

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
Thank you, youngster.
You've stopped my disciple
and helped me make up
with an old friend...
^3355FFNagash Arses put his palm on your back, and you can feel his strength flowing into you.^000000
^3355FFYou grow dizzy, but you also feel like you're becoming more powerful and gaining experience.^000000

^3355FFThen...
Everything blacks out...^000000

^3355FFHe looks tired
for some reason,
as if he's thinking
of Morocc, his hometown.^000000
^3355FFYou reflect on when he gave you his remaining strength and remember that he told you that he used to be one of the greatest Assassins...^000000

^3355FFBut after all that's happened,
he just looks like an old man who likes treating other people. It seems that he's finally at peace with himself.^000000

scripts.speaker: Nagash Arses
scripts.text:
My name, Nagash Arses,
is also the name of the poison king in the legend of Arcturus. I have good reason to be proud of my name!

^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
You're carrying too many items with you right now. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Let's see, there's that medicine, and then the medicine over here...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I feel like you're looking at me. Is there something that you want?
Ask him about his master.
Ask about Poison Organization.
Ask why he's working here.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I guess there's nothing you really need from me. Well then, if you'll excuse me...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm kind of busy right now. You see, we're running out of medicine...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
My master, Hua Tuo,
is also having difficulty treating all of his patients. I must get him the medicine that he needs...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
What...?
What did
you just say...?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I've never heard of that organization in my life. I'm sorry I can't help you. Now, if you'll excuse me...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Of course I'm working here to learn about medicine. I'm grateful for the chance to work under the most famous doctor in this area.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Doctor Hua Tuo is such a great person. I'm more than happy to assist him in saving the lives of others with his medical knowledge.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Even though I'm just in charge of the medicine storage, I'm working hard to become his disciple someday.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: And working with Doctor Hua Tuo is really worthwhile. Well, sometimes it's really hard to supply medicine when we have too many patients though.
Why don't you gather medicinal herbs then?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
My job is keeping this storage.
I'm not supposed to leave my position. I need to organize the herbs, and make sure they're in good condition.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Well, well. Thank you for your trouble. I didn't expect you to gather all these herbs for us...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I suppose I underestimated you. By the way, do you know anything about poison?
Yes, I am kind of interested in it.
No, not at all.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Oh, I see. Well, if you have some time, why don't you go visit my old master in the slums?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: If you two get along, I will tell you something important.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Huh. I see. Well, thank you for your trouble once again. I hope you have a good time in Luoyang.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
...
So, did you talk
to my old master?
It seems he really
likes you.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: As you know, my master has been accused of something he didn't do! And they crippled his use of the martial arts!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I can't forgive what
they've have done to my master!
I want to grind their bones
to powder! And that's before
I kill them!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
He's innocent and all he did
was research poison with all
of his effort! And for that,
they destroyed him!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I was young
when it happened...
Too young to know
any martial arts.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I couldn't protect him.
All I could do was hide and
watch other people get killed.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I hate myself
for not being strong!
But, my body isn't suited
for martial arts.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
All I can do is maintain my weak body and make sure it's reasonably healthy. Even so, if it weren't for my master, I'd be dead
in the streets...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: It was my master who picked me up from the streets and cured me. So, I've decided to become a doctor and save as many lives as I can.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
But before
I do that,
I want ^FF0000revenge^000000!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
As I told you, I am weak.
Too weak... I know that from
the bottom of my heart.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: But...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I am knowledgable about medicine, especially the use of poison. I can tell you that I'm one of the best.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Poison can kill people but it can also be used to save lifes. The people who destroyed my master
will pay the price.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Do you understand
why I'm furious!?
But revenge isn't good.
Yes, I fully understand.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hmm...
I see.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I suppose you couldn't
understand the way I feel.
After all, you didn't have
to go through the same
things I did.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I suppose I expected too much, since my master likes you. How could you know the rage and
sadness that I feel!?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Fine.
Go do whatever
you were going to do.
I'm just disappointed...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Yes! Yes!
You do understand!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I volunteered for this medicine storage position so that I can secretly study poison! Now, the time for action has come!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Still, I'll need some materials to complete my research. Then, when
I succeed and create a poison pill, I'll need someone to carry my revenge out for me.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Since my body is so frail, I can't bear the tension and rage of seeing my lifelong enemy face to face.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I'm so disappointed.
You've even seen the
pitiable state of my
master for yourself!
How could you not
understand me?!
I'm sorry for last time.
No matter what, revenge isn't good.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
If you really
feel sorry for me,
then you must help me
carry out my revenge!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I still need to complete the
poison potion I'm creating. I hope you can bring what I need to finish it. Go and get me...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
^0000FF4 Bee Sting,
10 Venom Canine,
10 Empty Potion,
30 Green Potion^000000.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: An apology is fine, but you must also show me that you are sorry and help me carry out my plan. Do you have any problem with this?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Oh, forget about it.
I don't think I can ever
make you understand how I feel.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
So, did you
gather everything
I asked of you?
Yes.
What do you need again?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah...
With these, I accept your apology. Thank you for all the trouble you went through to get this stuff.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Now that you're this involved, you're in this with me all the way! I've been waiting for this
day for years...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
All that's left is to create this poison, and then to get the
lord of Luoyang to drink it...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Where are things
I asked you to bring?
Are you testing my
patience or what?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: You're still missing some of the items I need. I must have them all in order to finish making this poison!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
*Sigh...*
Go and get me...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
^0000FF4 Bee Sting,
10 Venom Canine,
10 Empty Potion,
30 Green Potion^000000.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah, hello.
Please give me a minute,
I've just received a message.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah!
It says here
that my delivery
has finally arrived!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Would you bring me the
box from the firecracker
lady at the entrance
to Luoyang? Thanks
in advance.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah. Thank you,
I needed this. Now,
shall we begin?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Then, I add Green Herb extract, poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy into the liquid! Finally, I must heat them all!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Finally, I have to carefully heat the mixture and collect it all into a Potion Bottle.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Now, I've got to do this just right. This is a very delicate procedure...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: No!! I failed again! ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 And I spent a long time preparing all of those materials...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah, hello.
Please give me a minute,
I've just received a message.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah!
It says here
that my delivery
has finally arrived!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Would you bring me the
box from the firecracker
lady at the entrance
to Luoyang? Thanks
in advance.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Oh! You brought
me everything I need!
I'm very impressed!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
You're the only one
who actually understands how
I feel. Thank you for gathering all of these ^FF0000materials^000000.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Alright, now
to create the poison.
This is going to be tough.
Here we go...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Then, I add Green Herb extract,
a poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Finally, I have to carefully heat the mixture and collect it all into a Potion Bottle.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
*Phew...*
Did...
Did I make it?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hahaha~!
Success! 
It works!
I finally created it!
Mwahahahahahah!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Muhahahahaha!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Muhahahahaha!
Hahahahahahahahahahah!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I made it!
I made it!
Now, revenge will be mine!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hahaha! Now, please
take this bottle. But be careful. Even if you smell it just a little, it can cause your body to decompose, leading to death.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Then I add Green Herb extract, a poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Then I must carefully heat the mixture, and gather it all into a potion bottle.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
*Phew...*
Did...
Did I make it?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: NO! I... I've failed again! And I spent a long time getting everything ready...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
I'm not sure what went wrong.
Hmm, would you please help me again? I've used all the materials from last time.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
^0000FF4 Bee Sting^000000,
^0000FF10 Venom Canine^000000,
^0000FF10 Empty Potion Bottle^000000,
^0000FF30 Green Potion^000000 and
^0000FF1 Large Jellopy^000000.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
That's everything I'll need.
I would apologize, but since you've shown that you'll help carry out my revenge, I know you'll understand.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hahahaha...!
Now, time has come.
With this poison, Luoyang's
lord will be cast into hell!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
If they lied about my master,
then I'll simply make their lies into truth. Then, my master
won't feel victimized!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Lord Bai Long!
You will die!
Ha HA HA HA HA!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Muhahahaha!
Hahaha...Haha..hahaha..haha...hahahahaha...mmmmuhahahahahahahaha!!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Muhahahahahaha!
...........

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah, forgive me.
I was overly excited.
Yes, I must calm down...

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Now, I have one last favor to ask of you. Please sneak into the Castle of the Dragon.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: I want you to put this poison some place where Lord Bai Long might stay. But be careful, the castle has a lot of security.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Still, you're an adventurer from Midgard. You've probably had challenges like this before, so I'm sure you'll find a way.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Anyway, I'm sure my master
will be happy to know that
I finally created the ^0000FFpoison
he wished to create^000000!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hahaha...!
Master, I did it!
Your disciple Song Zhi Du made the world's deadliest poison for you!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Remember...
The Castle of the Dragon
is under heavy surveillance.
I guess Lord Bai Long is
insecure. Heh heh.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Anyways, I hope you'll be
really careful. When you go in, don't forget to use this poison somewhere the Lord Bai Long
can ingest it.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Anyway, I'm sure my master
will be happy to know that
I finally created the ^0000FFpoison
he wished to create^000000!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hahaha...!
Master, I did it!
Your disciple Song Zhi Du made the world's deadliest poison for you!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Leave now,
my friend!
For my revenge!
Go and kill Lord Bai Long!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah!
You came back!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah yes.
All I have to do now
is wait and hear news
of Lord Bai Long's death.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Thank you so much, my friend. You've satisfied my old grudge.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Now, I am getting tired.
Let me rest... Take care, my friend, and travel in safety.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
But before you go, let me give you some poison and a medicinal pill.
I made these with the leftover materials and medicine in the storage.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Please take the
medicine pill
right away.

^3355FFYou swallowed a strange pill
that shines with a gold color.
It tastes bitter...^000000
^3355FFThe nasty taste lingers in your mouth, but then you feel a great warmth flowing throughout your body. Eventually, you pass out.^000000
^3355FFSong Zhi Du looks blankly at the ceiling. With his revenge, it seems he's lost his motivation in life. Was it a good idea to help him, after all?^000000
^3355FFBy hearsay, the poisoned drink didn't work so well, as a Thief from a foreign land actually stole the bottle.^000000

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
What happened?
Why isn't
Lord Bai Long dead yet?!

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
You don't have
a different plot
in mind, do you?

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Ah...
Welcome.
My master told
me everything.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Somehow, I feel relieved, but sorry at the same time. Still, now I can forget everything that's happened in the past.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Now, I've decided to focus more on my medical studies so that I can really save as many lives as I can. I'm sorry I've been so rude to you before.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Also, I hope you will
take these, since I don't
need them any longer.

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text:
Thank you
once again, friend.
Now, if you'll excuse me,
I have many things to do...
^3355FFSong Zhi Du is busily engaged with organizing medicinal herbs. The faint look of sadness that used to be on his face now seems drained.^000000
^3355FFStill, from his movements and the pace at which he is working, you can tell that he loves what he is doing. It seems that Song Zhi Du has finally found his life's path.^000000

scripts.speaker: Song Zhi Du
scripts.text: Nagash Arses is also the name of poison king in a legend of Arcturus. There's good reason for my master to be proud of his name!

^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
Currently, you're carrying too many items. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000

scripts.text:
You're at the
entrance of Luoyang.
I hope you enjoy
your stay here~

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text: You're at the entrance of Luoyang.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Luoyang is well known
for its various firecrackers.
Would you like to see one?
Sure!
No thanks~

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text: Alright, there you go!

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text: Hmpf...!

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Would you
like to see some
firecrackers?
Sure!
No thanks~

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Alright,
there you go!

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Hmm, if not firecrackers,
then you must want something
else. Did someone send you?
Yes.
No.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Who was it?
Please tell me
his name.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Oh, I see.
Let me give
you the package.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Ah, wait! I forgot!
You must first pay the
delivery fee of 1,000 zeny.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Thank you~
Now that the fee is paid,
please bring this to
Song Zhi Du.
Take care!

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Errr...
You don't have enough zeny for the fee. I can't give you the package unless the delivery fee is paid!

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Hmmm?
I don't know who that is.
So I definitely don't have
a package for whoever you're
talking about.

scripts.speaker: Lady
scripts.text:
Are you...
Coming on to me?

scripts.text:
You're at the
entrance of Luoyang.
I hope you have a good time~

Alright~
There you go!

Huh...?
What was
that noise?

scripts.text:
Huh...?
Is somebody there?

Luoyang is such a great city.

Thank you so much.

up with an old friend!

scripts.speaker: Lord Bai Long
scripts.text:
I, Bai Long, will work on giving

scripts.text:

Thank you so

Ah, don't bother

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
Where there's a will,
there's a way. When we
work together, there's
nothing we cannot do.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Will you lend us your power, and help us build a better future? Will you join our movement for social reform in Luoyang?

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: It doesn't matter if you're a local or a foreigner. So long as we share the same goal of creating a better Luoyang, where everyone is treated as an equal.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
My name...
is Sun Mao.
This invitation may be sudden, but I am a man of action. I see in your face that you too despise injustice.
What am I supposed to do?
I will join you!
Well, I'm just another tourist...

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: For now, we must recruit as many members as we can. When we're ready, we'll start a movement that will change Luoyang, and even the world!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: However, we currently do not have the manpower to carry out the plans we have laid out. We've been lucky the lord hasn't found us out yet.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: I wish everyone would understand our intentions, but the people of this city are disunited. This is not the first time I have approached a foreigner for help...

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: I suppose you understand the urgency of our cause, and our need to gather others who see the merit of our goals!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Oh, God must be on my side today and has sent you to me. Thank you for making the big decision...

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
I shall then engrave your name
on this bloody pledge board. But before I do so, I shall ask once more. Do you truly wish to join us, through pain and bloodshed?
No, wait!
I am 100% sure.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: I understand if you need time to decide. If you do decide to join us, please return. Time is on our side, after all.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
{0}...!
Your name is now engraved on this bloody pledge board. We will fight together to the death for Luoyang's future!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Now, the most important thing for our cause is to gather more recruits and increase our numbers. Please find others who will join us in our fight.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: However, as to not arouse suspicion, bring only one new recruit at a time. Also, we suggest not to bring a friend in a party with you.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Now, I will wait for you here. Go forth and find others who wish for a better future for Luoyang!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Please assist the people who fight behind you. As more are gathered, one of our comrades will inform you of further instructions.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Are you...? I see, you may leave now. Do not reveal what you have seen or heard in this place.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: If you're a real tourist, you do not want to get involved in our business, one way or another.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
Once again,
thank you for
your trouble.
Go back safe.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Oh, you brought a new comrade! Welcome. Please help your friend understand our intentions before joining us.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Please bring another friend that both of you can trust. Remember, add one person at a time into your party.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: The three of you may all move together for our cause. Please try to find another recruit to be your fourth member, invite him to your party and bring him to this place.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Ah, now there are four of you. However, we must continue to strengthen our ranks at a cautious pace. Please go and find one new recruit, and only one, to add to your party.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Now, there are five of you. Needless to say, we still require more manpower. Please go out and seek another new member for our cause. Remember, only add one more person to your party and return to me.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: There are now six of you. So far, so good. Please go forth and find just one more person to add to your party and bring him to me so that we may recruit him.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Now, there are seven of you, but we still lack the manpower we need. Please go forth and seek out one, and only one, more person to add to your party and then return to me.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Great work, you've brought another new comrade! Welcome! Please explain our goals and the righteousness of our cause to our new friend so that he may fully join us.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Otherwise, other people may learn of what we are doing, and that will lead to trouble.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Great work, you've brought another new comrade! Welcome! Please explain our goals and the righteousness of our cause to our new friend so that he may fully join us.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: It is almost time to take the action...

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: I recognize your pledge to fight for us, but I fear that you are not yet ready for the task I have available for you.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: However, we still have time. Go out and train with the party members you have gathered to gain more experience.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Together, all of you will be able to train faster than if you were to go train alone. Come back when you feel that you are ready for this task.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: At long last, there are eight of you. Now, I believe there is among manpower amongst you to carry out this mission. Please listen carefully.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: The martial arts organizations of Luoyang, as you may well know, have been divided between those that fight for justice, and those that serve evil purposes.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Recently, some of the evil organizations have conspired with corrupt government officials in the interest to expand their power.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: These corrupt government officials have been suspicious of our gunpowder research and arrested our comrade, ^3355FFHao Chenryu^000000, our gunpowder expert, under the pretext of investigation.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Without him, we cannot continue the gunpowder research, or produce the gunpowder we'll need for our movement. We must contact him so that he may make gunpowder for us.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Unfortunately, many of us cannot contact him, as our identities are known to the officials. However, since you are new recruits, as well as Midgardians, they will not know how you are.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Your mission will be to deliver these chemicals to our comrade Hao Chenryu who is held captive by the government.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Since flammable chemicals are not allowed inside government offices, you must keep them well hidden. If the chemicals are equally divided among the eight of you, we might succeed!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: There you go. Now, divide these materials equally among the eight of you. The eight of you must fully cooperate with each other, or our plan will fail. Understood?

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: You made a party. Now, why don't you go recruit more followers? For now, just add one more person, lest we arouse the suspicion of our enemies.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding a third person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding a forth person to add to your party? I understand that it's important that you find someone you can trust. Be careful and don't get caught!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Having trouble finding a fifth person to add to your party? I understand that it's important that you find someone you can trust. Be careful and don't get caught!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Having trouble finding a six person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Having trouble finding a seventh person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding an eighth person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Oh no! You've brought more than one more person to join us! We can't do any recruiting now, it will bring unnecessary attention to our activities!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Please make sure that there is a total of two members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: At this stage in our plan, we cannot afford any unnecessary attention to our activities! Please make sure that there is a total of three members in your party so that we can recruit your friend.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Please make sure that there is a total of four members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Please make sure that there is a total of five members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: By this time, you should know that you should only bring one more person at a time. You know that it is crucial that we do not attract any undue attention before we can take action!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: At this stage in our plan, we cannot afford any unnecessary attention to our activities! Please make sure that there is a total of eight members in your party so that we can recruit your friend.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Welcome back! I see that the mission has been successfully accomplished! Great work, men!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Finally, we have a weapon to mete out severe retribution to our enemies, the corrupt government officials and the evil martial arts organizations! I appreciate your help, comrades.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Please take these funds and share them with your party members. I hope that all of you will lend your power to our cause once again.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Once again, I thank you for your help. Now, go in safety.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Your mission is to take the materials I have given you and your party members, and to smuggle them to Hao Chenryu.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Hao Chenryu is currently held captive by corrupt members of the government. Remember to divide the materials equally among your party members so that the officials do find them.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Huh, where are all your members? Come back to me with all of your recruits.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Remember that you move together with your comrades. There isn't a traitor amongst you, is there?

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text:
Ah...
You have
returned!
Ha ha ha ha!

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: I would like to commend you and your comrades for your excellent performance in the last mission. Come back anytime if you wish to be assigned to another task for our cause.

scripts.speaker: Sun Mao
scripts.text: Remember that the authoritative center of the party is its leader. The party members must act as one in order to accomplish their goals.

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
Who...
Are you?

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text: I only trust my comrades in the cause for Luoyang, so leave me alone. Death before oppression! Freedom for Luoyang!

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
Mao told me that eight Midgardians
would be coming.
But what happened?
I'm confused...

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
Mao's plans are flawless,
so I'm sticking to the scenario he's drawn up. You're either improvising needlessly, or you're not really my comrade...

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
Ah, I see that Mao
has sent you. I'm sorry
for the trouble you've
gone through to smuggle
the chemicals to me, comrade.

scripts.text:
Please give me
a minute so that
I may quickly make
the gunpowder.

scripts.text:
Is...
Something wrong?!

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
I guess we must
be extra careful,
as there is much
surveillance in
this place.

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
It seems like
you're one of us.

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
If you came for the
gunpowder, you should
get some chemcials
from your party leader.

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text:
Be careful!
It's easy for
gunpowder to be
found during the
inspection process!
Hide it well...!

scripts.speaker: Hao Chenryu
scripts.text: I hope you bring the gunpowder to Mao safely. The next time you see him, please give him my thanks.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: Hold on there!

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
You're not allowed to bring any gunpowder out of here. Now go
and put it back, Midgardian! Move!

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
It's strange to see outsiders in this kind of place. We don't have any business with you,
so move along.

scripts.text:
I am sorry, but it is prohibited to enter with some of the products
you are carrying. I cannot let you in.
